scope: Registered sixteen-row completed-data facet attribution at two temperatures, four preparations and two timesteps. Wide seed only; internal implemented-model evidence, no physical or validation claim.

definitions.geometry: Exact seed plus attachment-coordinate reconstruction; subtract own initial occupied count and axial/maximum Cartesian lateral center spans. Occupied cells are not mass.
definitions.time: Existing window/contrast and bracketCavityTime definitions unchanged. At-or-before state plus next recorded event; exact time uses exact state only. No interpolation or confidence interval.
definitions.comparisons: Common age uses the minimum terminal physical age across all sixteen rows. Cumulative and consecutive quarter windows are distinct. Five registered contrasts do not assume preparation effects add linearly.
definitions.limits: No grid/domain qualification, physical causal mechanism or interpolation between temperatures. Axial stability does not imply occupied-count stability.
definitions.triplet: [at-or-before value, minimum, maximum over adjacent recorded endpoint alternatives]; not a confidence interval or a continuous-time bound.
definitions.axialCells: Change in total occupied axial layer count after subtracting initial seed; each layer equals 0.35 micrometres of total axial center span.
definitions.lateralCartesianCenterSpanUm: Change in maximum Cartesian lateral occupied center span, in micrometres.
definitions.attachedCount: New attached lattice sites after subtracting the initial 37 sites; not deposited mass.
